name: The Emerald Dreamcatcher
summary: In Dolanaar, Tallonkai Swiftroot asks you to retrieve the Emerald Dreamcatcher from his abandoned home in Starbreeze Village. Gaerolas Talvethren gave him the heirloom, but corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs drove him from the village before he could take it. Its gentle magic still waits there.

sections.title: A Druidic Talisman
sections.body: Gaerolas Talvethren gave Tallonkai a rare druidic talisman. The warden watches over the sleeping druids in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The amulet channels the serene currents of the Emerald Dream, bringing peace and fortune to its bearer. Such gifts go only to a trusted few whose lives are bound to the forest's care.

sections.title: Fleeing Starbreeze Village
sections.body: Starbreeze Village was peaceful until the Gnarlpine furbolgs fell to violent madness. They drove the villagers from their ancestral homes. In the fearful flight, Tallonkai left his most treasured possession hidden in his dresser in the village's southeastern quarter. Alone, he could not reclaim it.

sections.title: The Threat of Corruption
sections.body: The Emerald Dreamcatcher carries the Dream's power, and the Gnarlpine have fallen under dark influences. That magic could be tainted or turned to harm. Returning the amulet to Tallonkai keeps its lingering power from the furbolgs and other foul denizens. It also restores a piece of Starbreeze's heritage to him.

faq.answer: Gaerolas Talvethren gave Tallonkai a rare amulet that draws energy from the Emerald Dream. The warden tends the sleeping druids in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Its magic brings good fortune and spiritual harmony to its bearer.

faq.q: Why was the dreamcatcher left behind in Starbreeze Village?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs overran Starbreeze Village in a violent frenzy. Tallonkai Swiftroot fled to Dolanaar, leaving the heirloom hidden in his bedroom dresser.
Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf refugee in Dolanaar. He escaped Starbreeze Village and seeks brave travelers to recover his family heirlooms and druidic relics from the occupied ruins.
Tallonkai says Gaerolas Talvethren gave him the dreamcatcher. Gaerolas watches over the sleeping druids in Ban'ethil Barrow Den, but no one says who made the amulet.

faq.q: Where in Starbreeze Village is the dreamcatcher located?
faq.answer: The dreamcatcher rests in Tallonkai's dresser in the far southeastern house in Starbreeze Village. Gnarlpine furbolgs now prowl the house heavily.

faq.q: What happens after the dreamcatcher is returned?
faq.answer: After Tallonkai inspects the recovered amulet, he finds its emerald missing. Ferocitas the Dream Eater, leader of the Gnarlpine, stole it, and the hunt for him begins.

angles.text: As a druid, you know Gaerolas Talvethren as the warden tending your sleeping kin in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Recovering the dreamcatcher he gave Tallonkai is a matter of druidic honor.
Starbreeze was once a tranquil haven for your people. Helping Tallonkai recover his heritage strikes a small blow against the madness seizing Teldrassil's wildlife.
By aiding the displaced Kaldorei of Dolanaar, you help secure local stability as corruption spreads among Teldrassil's furbolg tribes.
